name: Palisades State Park (Queen Campground)
waterfront_evidence: 2026-11-22: Esri World_Imagery (Minnehaha County orthos 2023-04-01) at 380 m half-width (0.84 m/px) and 130 m half-width (0.29 m/px) over Queen's north end, every Go Outdoors SD facID=44 loop 125 unit plotted; both rendered. The RV sites nearest Split Rock Creek, 93E and 95E, sit ~60 m and ~75 m from the bank with the loop road, tent site 94 and a belt of bank trees between; the other electric sites (85E-89E, 92E, 98E-111E) are farther east under the trees. The creek is ~20-32 m wide along the campground (a creek), so no view value applies; tent sites 78-84, 90, 91, 94 and cabins C5-C8 are the ones nearer the water and don't count -> not waterfront.
inclusion_evidence: Go Outdoors SD engine https://reservations.gooutdoorssouthdakota.com/FacilityDetails.aspx?facID=44 (facilityName 'Palisades State Park'), sitesHashMap read 2026-11-22, loop 125 (Queen): 22 web-bookable electric RV sites 85E-89E, 92E, 93E, 95E and 98E-111E, UnitBasePrice $30; 17 'Back-In Campsite' with MaxEquipLength 62-84 ft and 5 'Pull-Off Campsite' 98E-102E at 25 ft; 'Amp Service: 50' (85E: '20,30, 50'); tent-only 78-84, 90, 91, 94, 96, 97 ($16); camping cabins C5-C10 ($60); host V2 not sold online. GFP Queen Campground map https://gfp.sd.gov/userdocs/palisades_queen_cg.pdf (2024-05-24): sites 78-111, cabins 5-10, Restroom/Shower by 85E, vault toilets, water. GFP page: 'Park Size: 2 campgrounds, 111 campsites'. Esri imagery 2026-11-22: a wooded loop with spurs at the unit points, reached by its own road north from the day-use area. Real drive-in RV campground; a 23-ft rig fits every RV site (shortest 25 ft, the pull-offs). 1,238 m from King Campground RV-site centroid to centroid (nearest RV sites 108E-ADA and 2E, 964 m). Not in the DB before (split from 5729 Palisades State Park, 2026-11-22). Public (state): no price gate.
note: Palisades State Park's original Queen Campground, in the trees above Split Rock Creek at the north end of the park, reached by the park road from the 256th St entrance past the day-use area and the historic bridge. Camping cabins and the park's group lodge are close by; the park's dump station is on the entrance road by King Campground, about 1.2 km south-west, which is a separate entry. --Claude

sites.note: Sites 98E-102E are 25-ft pull-offs along the loop road. Plus tent-only sites 78-84, 90, 91, 94, 96 and 97 and camping cabins C5-C10.

season.note: October 1 to April 30 the showers, flush toilets and water may be off; vault toilets stay open.

fees.note: GFP publishes this park's own rate: non-electric $16, electric $30 a night (the statewide $7 electrical fee is already in the electric figure). Residents and non-residents pay the same to camp; the entrance licence and the $10 non-resident reservation fee are what differ.
